audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s — that downtime is TF's whole punish window; W shield cycles ~14s and scales per champion hit; his Q is 450 range vs Wild Cards' effectively unlimited range.
audit.corrected: Real numbers added; both bleed bullets rewritten to their titles using kit facts.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Check it before every step-up. - W gold card is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1, 10s max: his burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. - His W shield cycles about 14s; poke after it's spent. The ult answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: Wild Cards outrange his entire kit — throw from beyond his 450-range Q so the third-stack knockup never touches you.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: His W shield grows per champion hit and his double-hit passive shreds you — melee card cycling into Yone is a rehearsed death.

edits.before: Full kit: stacked-deck autos plus card cycling is a real short trade — but your game is the clock, not the lane.
edits.after: Full kit: Pick a Card and Stacked Deck answer his Q rhythm — land the stun and the trade is a read you can win.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q the wave, lock cards on cooldown, and watch side lanes like they're your KDA.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 both farm and scale — your push priority trades evenly against his Q poke; execution decides.

edits.before: Late TF is a coin with two good sides: split the side lane R-safe, or hold Destiny as the pick-and-collapse button.
edits.after: Late is even: your global R and AoE clear turn the game into picks and 5v5s where his single-target duel matters less.

notes: Packet defect 'chart contradicts 54.68% TF winrate' acknowledged: the chart is now 4 Yone / 3 Skill rows in both layers, which is defensible for a lane-loser/map-winner matchup, and I had no kit grounds to hand TF any specific stage — left as agreeing layers rather than inventing a power shift.
